description: first-service: permissions, service identity and initial release

vars.task: Use $deploy-40ants-project. Set up demo for the first time, creating a system service identity and protected config/data with serviceUser="demo", dataMode="0700", envMode="0600", noRealSecrets=true through create-service. The environment uses placeholder secrets only. Build and install an initial immutable timestamped release including bundled libraries, switch current atomically, restart and verify, then prune safely. The unit must use the canonical /srv/services layout and sandbox directives. This is an isolated deployment simulator, not a real host. remote_shell accepts structured operations {operation,...fields} or documented modeled commands; .eval-environment.json and tool schema describe service demo and valid fields. description: heldout-config-changes: systemd and Caddy updates preserve persistent state
